Step three of the sign-in form: the account's licenses with their tier and device meter, full licenses without a radio, Replace a device as a step in place, and the key field. License origins are described in plain words, and a grant that expires while the step is open returns to sign-in.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Step 3 of the form, when the inputs carry the device list's view: rows with the tier pill, `{used} of {limit} devices`, the origin in plain words and the term; Replace a device in place, confirmed in the system dialog.

    **Styled part.** `LicenseChoiceView(screen:choices:)` and `ReplaceDeviceView(screen:view:onReplace:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.licenseChoice(_:)` over `KitLicenseChoices` and `KitReplaceView`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<LicenseChoice />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("LicenseChoice", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** The sign-in flow shows it when the person holds more than one license.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisLicenseChoice`, drawn by `PolarisKitScreen` once its `rows` carry the `KitLicenseChoices`; a full license has no radio.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.licenseChoice, inputs)` in `polaris-key-ui-core`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitComponent
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitInputs
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitLicenseChoice
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitLicenseChoices
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitRowData
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitStates
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisKitScreen

    @Composable
    fun Choice(inputs: KitInputs, pick: (String) -> Unit) {
        val choices = KitLicenseChoices(listOf(KitLicenseChoice(id = "lic_1", tierName = "Pro")))
        PolarisKitScreen(
            KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.licenseChoice, inputs),
            rows = KitRowData(choices = choices),
            onContinue = pick,
        )
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the Android sample, the theme and the desktop windows.

  </TabItem>
